viewing_check: Estimate A$20-40, current bid A$45, so already above estimate and there is no first edition upside. Only reason to look: open Peanuts Jubilee for a Schulz signature or drawing on the endpaper/title page, check whether it is the Holt Rinehart hardback in jacket, and fan through the Topolino stack for any issue earlier than the 1960s (cover date top right). If none of that turns up, pass or cap at about A$60 all-in.
